working: Alumni eNews is the highest-lift program: Alumni eNews - July 2026 (2026-07-09) drove +77.2% lift on only 1,028 sends, and Alumni eNews: Final Reminder - June 2026 drove +65.2% — both beating the 8,900-send Staff-Client list.
Open rates are far above the 25-35% health/nonprofit benchmark: 51.62% average across 100 campaigns, with Alumni eNews - July 2026 at 57.3% and Alumni eNews - June 2026 at 55.81%.
Organic Search grew +14 sessions since the 08-12 run (10,720 -> 10,734) and now holds 33.6% of the 31,980-session window, the only channel adding meaningful volume run over run.
GSC position improved sharply this window: impression-weighted average position 14.16 vs 20.10 on 08-12, with indexed pages up 68 -> 94 and impressions up 1,546 -> 3,502.
Staff-Client eNews - February 2026 remains the click benchmark at 3.85% click / 8.33% click-to-open alongside +45.9% lift — proof the big list can perform when the content lands.
not_working: Severe UTM leakage: the Email channel has just 17 sessions (0.1%) across the entire 1,100-day window despite 317,115 total newsletter sends, while Direct holds 16,190 sessions (50.6%). Recent sends confirm it — the 2026-07-20 pair returned 2 email sessions vs 21 direct, and 2026-07-16 returned 4 email vs 35 direct.
The most recent send underperformed: Staff-Client eNews - July 2026 (2026-07-20, 8,906 sends) posted a 0.43% click rate and -27.3% lift — the weakest click rate of any 2026 send.
Click rates are the weak half of the funnel: 1.94% average click against a 51.62% average open. Great subject lines, weak in-email calls to action.
Referring Partners eNews opens at 26.49-27.35%, at the bottom of the 25-35% benchmark and ~20 points below every other BCC list — this is the referral-source list and it is the least engaged.
Organic Social sits at 1,722 sessions (5.4%) and added zero sessions since the 08-12 run.

Constant Contact auth is still broken: constant-contact-fetch.py exited 2 with 401 invalid_client on token refresh. All newsletter figures above come from cached data — no send has been ingested since 2026-07-20.
do_next: Fix the Constant Contact OAuth client secret (401 invalid_client on refresh, failing since 2026-08-10) — see CONSTANT-CONTACT-SETUP.md. Newsletter data has been frozen at the 2026-07-20 send for over three weeks.

Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=<send-name> to every link in the next newsletter. At current volumes this should reclassify roughly 20-50 sessions per send out of Direct and into Email, making newsletter ROI measurable for the first time.

Repromote Alumni-list content themes — Alumni eNews and its reminder variants produced the top three lifts of the last 12 months (+77.2%, +65.2%, and a reminder at +1.5%) on ~1,000 sends, better per-recipient than the 8,900-send Staff-Client list.

Rebuild the Staff-Client CTA: model the next send on Staff-Client eNews - February 2026 (3.85% click, 8.33% CTO, +45.9% lift) rather than the July 2026 send (0.43% click, -27.3% lift). Single dominant CTA above the fold.
Rewrite Referring Partners subject lines and cadence — 26-27% opens on a 958-address list of referral sources is the highest-value engagement gap BCC has right now.

Bank the SEO gain: with average position at 14.16 and 94 pages showing impressions, prioritize on-page work for pages sitting in positions 11-20, where small moves convert impressions into the clicks that currently total only 42.
summary: Over the 1,100-day window BCC logged 31,980 sessions, led by Direct at 16,190 (50.6%) and Organic Search at 10,734 (33.6%), while the Email channel registered only 17 sessions against 317,115 newsletter sends — the clearest possible signal that newsletter links carry no UTM tags and GA4 is mis-crediting email traffic as Direct. Open rates remain excellent (51.62% average, Alumni eNews - July 2026 at 57.3% with +77.2% lift) but click rates average 1.94%, and Constant Contact ingestion has been stalled since 2026-07-20 on a 401 invalid_client token-refresh failure.
